I need to consider the factual history of the Internet's origins.

The Internet originated from ARPANET (Advanced Research Projects Agency Network), which was developed by the United States Department of Defense's Advanced Research Projects Agency (ARPA, later DARPA). The first ARPANET link was established between UCLA and Stanford Research Institute in California in 1969. This project was funded by the U.S. government and conducted at American research institutions.
